hypotheses.T0_pure_semantic_program_transfers: At some tested layer, every ordered pure-model pair has global-ridge median semantic effect fidelity at least 0.50.
hypotheses.T1_semantic_program_is_not_a_neuron_perm: At the best pure semantic layer, mean global-ridge fidelity exceeds mean native-permutation fidelity by at least 0.15.
hypotheses.T2_tensor_write_quotient_transfers_seman: At some tested layer, every ordered pure-model pair has write-quotient semantic effect fidelity at least 0.50.
hypotheses.T3_relation_conditioning_improves_semant: At some tested layer, mean relation-conditioned semantic fidelity exceeds global-ridge fidelity by at least 0.10.
hypotheses.T4_arbitrary_fact_swaps_do_not_share_one: At every tested layer, mean mixed-model global-ridge arbitrary-swap fidelity is below 0.30.
hypotheses.T5_tensor_quotient_recovers_arbitrary_sw: At some tested layer, mean mixed-model write-quotient arbitrary-swap fidelity exceeds global-ridge fidelity by at least 0.15 and reaches 0.30.
hypotheses.T6_semantic_transfer_is_more_recurrent_t: At the best pure semantic layer, mean global-ridge semantic fidelity exceeds unrestricted-pair fidelity by at least 0.20.
hypotheses.T7_own_delta_is_an_effectful_ceiling: For every regime, family, and layer entering a verdict, at least 64 evaluation rows pass the frozen Fisher-effect norm gate.
